answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32495 Country: India Title: Please may i know exact time of subah e kaazib? Question: Please may i know exact time of subah e kaazib? Answer ID: 32495 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1043/1043/M=1432) The time of Fajr salah starts from Subh Sadiq (true dawn). The time before it is called Subh Kazib (false dawn). The sign of Subh Kazib is that a light appears in length in the sky like the tail of wolf, after that darkness overspreads for a few time, as it is mentioned in Shami: لا الكاذب وهو المستطيل الذى يبدو طويلا في اسماء كذنب السرطحان اى الذئب ثم يعقبه ظلمة . (شامي زكريا 2/14) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
